songInfo.title: Rooster
songInfo.tuning: Half-Step Down (Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb)

scalesUsed.notes: F# - G# - A - B - C# - D - E
scalesUsed.application: Underpins the brooding verse tonality and vocal harmonies between Layne Staley and Jerry Cantrell

scalesUsed.notes: F# - A - B - C - C# - E
scalesUsed.application: Jerry Cantrell's vocal-style wah solo phrasing and stinging bent double-stops

scalesUsed.notes: F# - G# - A - B - C# - D# - E
scalesUsed.application: Supplies the bright major 6th (D#) color in the clean arpeggiated intro fills

keyAndScale.modalCharacter: Brooding, atmospheric 90s alternative grunge masterpiece built on dramatic soft-loud contrast, modulating chorus/flanger clean verses, and apocalyptic walls of drop-tuned distorted guitars
keyAndScale.relativeMinor: A major is the relative major

mainProgression.description: Cyclical two-chord verse groove expanding into crushing chromatic grunge power chords in the chorus.

sectionProgressions.description: Hypnotic two-chord arpeggiated movement soaked in Electro-Harmonix Electric Mistress flanging
Rising chromatic tension with palm-muted power chords exploding into full distortion
Monolithic grunge power chords underscoring Layne Staley's soaring chorus vocals and Cantrell's wah solo

harmonicFunction: F#m (i) - Heavy, resonant minor tonic tuned down a half-step for deep low-end resonance
A (♭III) - Relative major submediant providing harmonic warmth and bittersweet contrast
B (IV) - Major subdominant introducing bright Dorian uplift before the heavy drop
C (♭V) - Tritone passing chord delivering visceral harmonic angst and dissonance

techniques.name: Dynamic Soft-Loud Grunge Contrast & Wah Phrasing
techniques.description: Transitioning seamlessly from delicate, modulated clean finger/pick arpeggios to thunderous Bogner/Marshall high-gain power chords with expressive cry-baby wah soloing

notes: Tuning: Tune down all 6 strings by one half-step (Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb)
Clean arpeggio: Low F# root (2nd fret low E) alternating with ringing open A string
Chorus impact: Dig in with aggressive, wide-angle downstrokes across full root-6 and root-5 power chords
sequence: Tune guitar to Eb standard tuning
Dial in a warm clean tone with subtle stereo chorus or flanger modulation
Master the smooth picking flow of the two-bar F#m - A verse arpeggio
Engage high-gain overdrive or distortion pedal on beat 1 of the chorus for maximum dynamic shock
tips: Allow the open strings to ring over chord transitions to create Jerry Cantrell's signature wide stereo acoustic/electric soundscape
Use a slow, sweeping motion on your wah pedal during the solo rather than fast funk rocking to mimic vocal singing
Keep your fretting thumb wrapped over the neck to anchor the low F# note on the 2nd fret

sections.name: Clean Intro & Verse Arpeggio
sections.description: Haunting two-chord arpeggio played through an Electro-Harmonix Electric Mistress flanger and chorus

sections.name: Heavy Chorus Riff
sections.description: Massive high-gain wall of sound locking with the bass and drums as the song explodes into the chorus

guitar.recommended: G&L Rampage (Jerry Cantrell Signature) with Seymour Duncan JB humbucker / Gibson Les Paul Standard
guitar.pickup: Bridge humbucker with high output for tight, saturated low-end crunch

amp.recommended: Bogner Fish Preamp through a Mesa Boogie Strategy 500 power amp / Marshall JCM800

effects.distortion: Cascading Bogner Fish high-gain tube distortion channel
effects.reverb: Subtle studio room reverb adding spatial width
effects.other: Electro-Harmonix Electric Mistress Flanger / Dunlop Jerry Cantrell Signature Cry Baby Wah
effects.chorus: Boss CE-2 chorus on clean verse guitar tracks

beginner.title: Tuning & Verse Arpeggios
steps: Tune your guitar down a half-step to Eb Standard (Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb)
Practice the clean F#m and A arpeggio patterns at 72 BPM
Switch smoothly between clean pick strokes and heavy chorus chords

intermediate.title: Dynamic Explosion & Power Grooves
steps: Master the sudden dynamic transition from whisper-quiet clean to crushing overdrive
Lock heavy downstroke power chords in the chorus with the kick drum
Learn the rising chromatic pre-chorus progression (F#5 - A5 - B5 - C5)

advanced.title: Vocal Wah Solo & Sonic Layering
steps: Learn Jerry Cantrell's vocal-style wah guitar solo note-for-note
Control foot sweeps on the wah pedal to match the vocal inflection and vowel sounds
Replicate the multi-tracked wall of sound in live or recording settings

commonMistakes: Forgetting to tune down to Eb Standard, making the song clash with the original recording
Over-playing during the verse arpeggio rather than letting the modulation effects breathe
Stomping too aggressively on the wah pedal instead of using slow, vocal-like sweeps
practiceRoutine: 10 minutes: Slow arpeggio picking drill over F#m and A with chorus/flanger
15 minutes: Downstroke power chord rhythm tightening with a metronome at 72 BPM
15 minutes: Wah pedal expression and pitch-bending accuracy over the solo progression
focusAreas: Dynamic control between clean verse and high-gain chorus
Eb Standard tuning accuracy and intonation
metronomeWork: Set metronome to 72 BPM in 4/4 time and practice landing heavy chorus downstrokes exactly on the downbeat
